text: The purpose of this report is to provide Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) Board of Directors with an update about key City policy initiatives, programs and projects potentially impacting Toronto Parking Authority. The status of Toronto Parking Authority facilities that have been identified for city building opportunities and initiatives or which are otherwise being redeveloped through joint venture projects is also provided. Further updates about city building activities involving Toronto Parking Authority facilities will continue to be provided to the Toronto Parking Authority Board of Directors on an as-needed basis.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority deferred consideration of the item until the May 15, 2025 meeting of the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority.
